searchTerms.title: Trade search terms (zh-TW)
searchTerms.description: Passed to the Maps actor as searchStringsArray, e.g. 水電工程, 泥作工程, 防水工程, 鋼構工程, 模板工程, 土木包工業. Defaults to config/gmaps-search-terms.json.

counties.title: Counties
counties.description: 縣市 to search across (one Maps run per county). Defaults to the canonical list from config/counties.json.

maxPlacesPerSearch.title: Max places per search term
maxPlacesPerSearch.description: maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch sent to the Maps actor. Keep low (50) for the spike.

mapsActorId.title: Apify Maps actor
mapsActorId.description: The maintained Google Maps Scraper actor to wrap.

useResidentialProxy.title: Use residential TW proxy
useResidentialProxy.description: Route the Maps actor through Apify residential proxy in Taiwan (recommended for anti-bot).
